registry.actual_scope: Complete current protocolSection and absent results/document modules inspected, not historical-version comparison or publication results reconstruction.
unresolved_discrepancies: Registry eligibility wording about other research participation is internally awkward; no repair inferred
registry.identity_contribution: Confirms monohydrate, oral separate-arm design and hot-cocoa/water-mixed administration; does not supply missing effect sizes or renal results.

BUB1B_scope.interpretation: Lexical scope only; no new scientific read credit. Assay phosphocreatine or creatine-kinase co-mentions do not demonstrate administered creatine monohydrate restoration. No worldwide absence claim.

disposition.proposed_route: Creatine monohydrate / pediatric muscle-strength compensation comparator
disposition.decision: Retain access-limited clinical muscle-strength reserve with mixed outcomes; not a demonstrated BUB1B-restoring or MVA treatment.
disposition.positive_basis: Actual pediatric randomized treatment evidence includes a manual-strength between-group result in2010 and reported dominant-hand grip benefit in2004; distinct from FFM or PCr/Pi alone.
disposition.negative_basis: 2005 primary strength null;2004 daily-function/task and2010 functional-scale nulls. Missing original secondary tables prevent calling CINRG globally negative.
disposition.comparison_to_niacin: More direct pediatric muscle-strength evidence than niacin’s cross-intervention restoration hypothesis; niacin retains separate human muscle NAD evidence. Neither has MVA benefit here.
disposition.comparison_to_apitegromab: Does not displace the repository’s randomized SMA motor-function comparator on these limited sources; no head-to-head or MVA superiority inferred.
disposition.eligibility: Exact monohydrate preparation; no retail-product, formulation, approval or safety equivalence inferred from catalog or NIH names.

unresolved_questions: Obtain lawful full originals: exact effect sizes and primary/hierarchical or multiplicity treatment.
For2004: randomized versus completed n, actual period/sequence/carryover analysis, washout sufficiency and exact grip contrast.
For2005: exact allocation/attrition and conflicting secondary timed-function interpretations; reconcile registry/publication differences.
For2010: analysis-specific MRS/MMT denominators, masking roles, effect sizes and prespecified subgroup tests.
For all: supplier/purity/batch/vehicle details and numerical safety/renal results; do not equate serum creatinine or qualitative tolerability with validated filtration or MVA safety.
